what: Counts by a person on the sheets of stage 1, for the accepted split. A measurement for the report, not a pass rule (docs/design.md, sections 4.3 and 4.5). split_meta.json is as scripts/make_split.py wrote it; this file holds what a person counted.

scene_pairs.what: A test image and its nearest train-pool image: 4 of the 8 sheets of the accepted split (docs/build_notes.md, section 12)

largest_group.what: 50 random images of the largest scene group (12,603 images), on largest_group.jpg

random_image_split.what: A test image and its nearest train-pool image in a random image split: 2 sheets of the third run, mean embedding (docs/build_notes.md, section 10)
